criterion: 兩個 Skill 專業職責與入口保留；ADR 共用格式／狀態／生命週期有單一權威來源且引用可解析，沒有平行重複定義；架構例外核准政策仍可檢查，不因一般 ADR 格式而繞過。
method: Model-assisted source/document review plus executable host regressions
finding: Reviewed general versus architecture ADR profiles: ordinary decisions use concise fields, architecture exceptions retain exact rule/location approval and baseline requirements.
limits: Rule/design governance acceptance; target runtime claims require separate project evidence.
